items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: Right. Joe Sepchik had brought me down. Joe Sepchik was one of Joe Morello’s students.

ctx.x: Right. Joe Sepchik had brought me down. Joe Sepchik was one of Joe Morello’s students. And he came into the lesson with me, and he was Joe Morello’s teacher and there was some small talk then I started to play. And Joe frightened me. He let me know exactly where I was on the totem pole, and I went for it. I went after it. I took the challenge and I worked very hard and really became a technique freak for a while, and wanted to get up to that level, and I did, but also Joe is a phenomenal teacher and he told me,…
Well I’m curious, that first time with him, and he said to you well play something. What do you play in a situation like that? Do you solo, do you play some time, or is it a combination of both?
